description: Compares the official 2026 property assessment (ejendomsvurdering), which sets the property tax from 2027, with the statistical market estimate for the same home, against the statutory 20 % rule that lets an owner ask for a reassessment. Returns the assessment, the estimate at the assessment date, the deviation, a verdict and the yearly tax at stake. Takes an address_id from search_address. A cold lookup can take up to a minute.
name: get_assessment_check
title: Check a home's 2026 property assessment

annotations.title: 2026 assessments against sale prices, by municipality

description: How often the indexed 2026 property assessment is more than 20 % above or below what homes actually sold for, for one Danish municipality beside the country, or (with no municipality) for the country with the ten highest and lowest municipalities. Built from public registers only.

municipality.description: Municipality name, e.g. "Randers" or "København". Omit for the national figures.

name: get_assessment_gap
title: 2026 assessments against sale prices, by municipality

annotations.title: A home's registered installations and changes

description: What the building register (BBR) records about one Danish home: solar panels, ground-source heat loops, oil tanks, and dated changes of heating and roof material. Takes an address_id from search_address. A missing record is not evidence that nothing was done.
name: get_home_history
title: A home's registered installations and changes

annotations.title: Recent home sales in a postcode

description: Registered home sales in a Danish postcode over the past year, per property type: count, median price, median price per m² and the most recent sales with links to their own valuations.
name: get_postcode_sales
title: Recent home sales in a postcode

description: Statistical market-value estimate for one Danish home: value, likely range, confidence, how it was calculated, the comparable sales it rests on, earlier registered sales and the yearly property tax a new owner would pay. Takes an address_id from search_address. A cold lookup can take up to a minute.
name: get_valuation
title: Estimate a home's market value

description: Search Danish addresses by free text (street, number, floor/door, postcode). Returns address ids to pass to get_valuation. Example query: "Kilevej 6, 1. mf, 2000".
name: search_address
title: Find a Danish address
